app.title: Smart Ticket Completion Assistant
app.description: Organize feedback with AI, ask for missing details, and prepare a defect ticket for review.
app.phaseHint: Organize known facts, answer focused questions, then review the report.
list.emptyHint: Add a user's original feedback to start a report.
detail.originalHint: Preserved exactly as submitted; supplementary facts belong below.
detail.supplementHint: Add the user's answers, environment or reproduction details.
detail.reportHint: Leave unknown fields blank. Confirming means you reviewed this report, not that the defect is fixed.
detail.snapshotHint: This snapshot stays unchanged while you edit a new draft.
field.title: Title
create.title: Capture original feedback
create.hint: Paste what the user actually reported. The original text is preserved after creation.
create.label: Original feedback
create.placeholder: For example: exporting orders keeps spinning…
discard.title: There are unsaved changes
discard.hint: Keep editing to save them, or discard this draft before continuing.
confirm.title: Confirm this report
confirm.hint: This saves a snapshot of the current report and additional facts. Unknown details remain unknown; this does not mean the defect was accepted or fixed.
error.invalid_input: Check the input length and required information, then try again.
error.scope_required: Select an organization and sign in to use this workbench.
error.not_found: This record is unavailable. Reload the list.
error.revision_conflict: This record changed in another page. Your draft is kept here. Copy your edits before reloading the latest saved version.
error.empty_report: Add a report title and actual result before confirming. Other unknown fields may remain blank.
error.storage_unavailable: The request could not be completed. Your draft is still here; check the connection and retry.
error.host_timeout: The platform did not respond in time. Your draft is kept; retry when the connection recovers.
error.host_request_failed: The platform request failed. Your draft is kept; try again.
analysis.title: AI organization & clarification
analysis.scope: Uses only this record’s feedback, supplements and answers. No live business system is connected.
analysis.error.queue_unavailable: The analysis could not be scheduled. Your report is saved; try again.
analysis.error.model_unavailable: The analysis model is unavailable. Your content is kept; check the configured model and retry.
analysis.error.model_timeout: The model took too long. Your content is kept; retry when ready.
analysis.error.invalid_output: The model result failed format or source checks and was not applied. Your content is kept; retry the analysis.
analysis.error.output_truncated: The model response reached its output limit and was not applied. Your content is kept; retry the analysis.
analysis.error.interrupted: The analysis was interrupted. Your content is kept; retry the analysis.
analysis.error.access_denied: The Assistant capability or access changed. Your content is kept; check access before retrying.
analysis.superseded: Saved content changed during analysis. The older result will not overwrite it. Analyze the latest saved version.
analysis.answerPlaceholder: Add only what you know; you may leave this blank.
analysis.answerHint: Save your answers with Save draft, then analyze again. Unknown details can stay blank.
analysis.noQuestions: No further questions suggested. Review the report before confirming.
analysis.suggestionKept: Your edit has been kept. This is a separate AI suggestion.
analysis.evidenceHint: The quote exists in supplied information. Please check that the suggestion accurately reflects it.
error.analysis_pending: Wait for this analysis to finish, or save a change to supersede it before confirming.
